header.title: Legacy Texture Converter
header.subtitle: Convert Java and Bedrock texture packs for Minecraft: Wii U Edition or Nintendo Switch Edition. Files stay in your browser.

upload.heading: Upload
upload.formats: ZIP, MCPACK, folder, or PNG files
upload.privacy: Processing is performed locally. Your files are not uploaded.

report.heading: Conversion results
report.switchReady: Atmosphère-ready Nintendo Switch Edition ZIP created

messages.guiSheetMissing: The source HUD sheet was not present, so its mapped Console Edition sprites remain unchanged.
messages.guiCopied: The original GUI PNG was copied without decoding or re-encoding.
messages.guiRenamedToWidgets: The original gui.png bytes were copied as widgets.png.
messages.guiCandidateNotSelected: A higher-confidence GUI texture candidate was selected.
messages.javaSkyResized: The Java 3x2 sky sheet was resized without changing its face layout.
messages.bedrockSkyCombined: The six Bedrock cubemap faces were combined in the verified LCE layout and resized.
messages.skyCandidateNotSelected: A higher-priority valid overworld sky candidate was selected.
messages.skyCandidateInvalid: This sky candidate was invalid and was skipped.
messages.skyCubemapSetSkipped: This cubemap set was incomplete or ambiguous and was skipped.

warnings.mixedItems: Mixed item resolutions were normalized to the largest safe power-of-two size.
warnings.mixedBlocks: Mixed block resolutions were normalized to a 32px terrain atlas.
warnings.nonSquare: A non-square texture could not be placed safely.
warnings.invalidPng: A PNG could not be decoded and was skipped.
warnings.animation: Animation metadata could not be interpreted; the target edition's default sequence was kept.
warnings.animationFixedOrder: This texture uses a fixed Console Edition animation order, so source animation metadata was not copied.
warnings.guiSheetDimensions: This GUI sheet is not a square integer multiple of 256px, so its HUD sprites were skipped and the Console Edition defaults were preserved.
warnings.guiMapping: The verified HUD mapping did not match this baseline, so the Media archive was left out of the output.
warnings.guiFuiValidation: The HUD FUI failed structural or image validation, so the Media archive was left out of the output.
warnings.guiArcValidation: The Media ARC failed structural validation, so it was left out of the output.
warnings.javaSkyDimensions: This Java sky is not a valid 3x2 sheet of six square faces and was skipped.
warnings.bedrockSkyMissingFaces: This Bedrock cubemap set does not contain all six faces and was skipped.
warnings.bedrockSkyUnexpectedFaces: This Bedrock cubemap directory contains faces outside cubemap_0 through cubemap_5 and was skipped.
warnings.bedrockSkyDuplicateFaces: This Bedrock cubemap directory contains duplicate face numbers and was skipped.
warnings.bedrockSkyDimensions: The six Bedrock cubemap faces are not equal-sized squares and were skipped.
warnings.multipleJavaSkyCandidates: Multiple Java sky candidates were found; the highest-priority valid candidate shown here was selected.
warnings.multipleBedrockSkyCandidates: Multiple Bedrock cubemap sets were found; the highest-priority valid overworld set shown here was selected.
warnings.skyConversion: The selected sky could not be rendered, so sky output was skipped.

errors.heading: Unable to continue
errors.empty-pack: No supported texture files were found in this pack.
errors.unknown-edition: Select Java Edition or Bedrock Edition for this input.
errors.baseline-incomplete: Wait for the published Wii U baseline to load, then try again.
errors.switch-baseline-incomplete: Wait for the published Nintendo Switch Edition baseline to load, then try again.
errors.baseline-invalid: The selected baseline contains an invalid image, Media archive, or unexpected resource layout.
errors.unsafe-path: The archive contains an unsafe path and was rejected.
errors.canvas-limit: The requested atlas is too large for a safe browser canvas.
errors.generic: The pack could not be processed. Check that the archive and PNG files are valid.

footer.note: Wii U and Nintendo Switch Edition outputs are built in the browser from edition-specific published baselines and verified resource layouts.
